author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Azahar 2126.0-rc4: official release candidate
summary: Azahar published 2126.0-rc4 on July 25, 2026. The release record documents an official release candidate for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2126.0-rc4 on July 25, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Fixed a crash which could occur when using a controller which has a physical touchpad (e.g. PlayStation controller). @DavidRGriswold 2314 2346. Fixed an issue where having a PS4/PS5 controller connected could cause Azahar to hang when launched. @DavidRGriswold 2345. Fixed an issue where auto-mapping could behave incorrectly with some controllers. @DavidRGriswold 2317. Assorted minor fixes relating to analog input. @DavidRGriswold 2348.
